audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart gave Ornn Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, but every whys line and the packet chart say Vladimir edges those stages and only Level 6 is Ornn's.
audit.why: 48.46% Ornn win rate over 2274 games, and whys[1] 'he edges the resource war', whys[3] 'he still out-pokes', whys[6] 'let your team handle him' all contradict an Ornn-favoured chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 realigned to the packet chart (Vladimir, Skill, Vladimir, Ornn, Skill, Vladimir) in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and coherent: Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, contested first item, Vladimir late on AP scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool was described only as 'dodges your combo' with no duration or cooldown, and the untargetability was never stated as such.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool (W) is 28/25/22/19/16s and makes him untargetable for 2 seconds — it fully eats Call of the Forge God and the E knockup if spent on reaction. Transfusion (Q) is 9s down to 4.6s and costs no resource. Hemoplague is a flat 120s and heals him per champion hit.
audit.corrected: Stated the 2s untargetability and 28s rank-1 cooldown, and tied Grievous Wounds to Transfusion/Hemoplague sustain.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already named in report[8].t and breakdown.late, which is the correct answer to Transfusion and Hemoplague.
audit.corrected: Reinforced the anti-heal reason in dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool (W): 28s at rank 1, 16s maxed — 2 seconds untargetable that eats your whole combo. Bait it, then commit. - Transfusion (Q): 9s and free, so chip never sticks without Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your combo. Bait it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool, 28s at rank 1: 2s untargetable eats R and E — bait it, then W-E-R inside 16s.

edits.before: Dodges your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 2s untargetable, 28s at rank 1 — never commit into an up pool.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Pool is spent — you have 28 seconds, so run the whole pattern now.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
